drafted_from: tool:keep-a-site-write's own row (tool-rows.json), do-work/keep-a-site-write.ts and read-data/site-writes.json
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep this lead from my site's book-a-call form." It runs tool:keep-a-site-write with the write site-lead and the form's values, and the lead is one row of the database's statements.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: each write adds or changes rows of the tables its fixed statement names in the pursuit database you give (statements, price_views, the welcome stop through stop_welcome_series).
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database the write goes to, such as example_for_who_runs_it, and the site's use; the computer opens it with the writer login its vault holds.
2. Name the write (site-lead, site-checkout, site-visit, price-view, email-course-stop or welcome-series-stop) and give its values by name; never SQL.
3. Read the answer: the write, how many rows it kept, and for the welcome stop the page to go to.

worked_examples.title: Keep a lead from a site form
worked_examples.ask: Keep this lead from my site's book-a-call form.
